stemMarkdown: The price of an article is increased by 44% and the new price is then decreased by 54%. Find the net percentage change in the price. (Enter a negative value for a net decrease.)
solutionMarkdown: Start from 100. After the increase: $100 \times (1 + 44/100) = 144.00$. After the decrease: $144.00 \times (1 - 54/100) = 66.24$. Net change $= -33.76\%$.
